title: Fungi Simulator
description:
From spore to sporemaster.

Start with a single mushroom. Grow it. Upgrade it. Then push deeper into the fungal kingdom.

With 4 unique mushroom types already waiting (and more on the way), each one demands 100,000 Spore Power from the previous tier — and doubles the challenge.

• Click to earn spores

• Upgrade your Click Power, Passive Generation, and Potency

• Unlock new Fungi with escalating difficulty

• Prestige and evolve for permanent bonuses (coming soon)

How far can your mycelium reach?
description_short: Become a single spore on a journey to blanket the world in mycelium. Click to grow, unlock new mushroom species, and watch your fungal empire expand even while you're away. Whether you have 5 minutes or 5 hours, Fungi Simulator is the perfect idle escape. No stress. Just growth.
